description: This Java test class verifies access to the Swagger UI and related JSON documentation endpoints in the Fineract project. It uses REST-assured to perform HTTP GET requests and checks for successful responses.

classes.name: SwaggeruiTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that checks access to Swagger UI and Fineract JSON documentation endpoints.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured setup and defines request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: testSwaggeruiAccess
methods.description: Performs GET requests to Swagger UI and JSON endpoints, asserting they are accessible with status code 200.
